title: Demo edit deep-link still never fetches its payload — r1 W11 fix didn't bite
detail: No VacancyEdit arm exists — the `_ -> []` catch-all swallows it, so refreshing /vacancies/v-maples/edit boots demo with an empty form. The boot route→fetch map is a third hand-maintained copy beside handle_browser_change and demo_update's AppRequested* arms; it drifted exactly as r1 W11 predicted.
recommended_fix: Add `routes.VacancyEdit(id) -> [demo_api.get_for_edit(store, id, ApiReturnedVacancyForEdit)]` to demo_entry_effects and set vacancy_edit_loading: True in enter_demo for that route.

title: Demo substitute still discards the typed referee contact (r1 W22 half-landed)
evidence:
// demo_store.gleam apply_refcheck:
    "substitute" ->
      ReferenceCallDetail(
        ..call,
        contact_name: None,
        contact_email: None,
        contact_phone: None,
      )

// the real flow (client.gleam:7446-7452) persists the typed trio:
                  reference_checks_api.substitute_reference(
                    vid,
                    aid,
                    call,
                    name,
                    email,
                    phone,
                    csrf,
                    on_response,
                  )
// demo_update.gleam UserSavedRefcheckEdit dispatches fire_demo_refcheck(model, call_id, "substitute") — no contact payload is threaded (demo_api.refcheck_action takes no contact args).
detail: Dispatch now distinguishes substitute from correct (the confusing correction_cycles bump is gone), but the r1 complaint's second half persists: the landlord's typed name/email/phone are wiped to None instead of stored, so the row loses its contact entirely — diverging from the real substitute semantics the demo mirrors.
recommended_fix: Thread the typed trio from model.refcheck_edit through demo_api.refcheck_action into apply_refcheck's "substitute" arm, setting contact_name/email/phone to the typed values.

title: Reset demo still strands non-dashboard pages on a spinner — r1 W13 fix didn't bite
detail: Reset refetches only notifications; on a detail/archived/comparison route every surface goes NotAsked with no refetch effect and no navigation, so the page renders view_loading() indefinitely. The briefing's required fold "reset navigates home" did not land.
recommended_fix: Push /demo from reset_demo (modem.push) or re-run demo_entry_effects(store, model.route) so the current route's data refetches after the reseed.

title: lint_demo_network.py allowlists 4 helpers as demo-branched that contain no demo branch
detail: 4 of 8 allowlisted helpers do not branch on demo_mode; their real api calls are safe only because demo_update intercepts the calling arms — a separately maintained list the lint trusts. Dropping one interception arm would escape the lint entirely: a vacuous class in the pillar-1 pin.
recommended_fix: Give the four helpers real demo_mode branches (as refetch_refcheck_effect does), or reclassify them under the interception-trust exemption with an honest comment.

title: demo_api.check_session is an orphaned mirror (0 call sites)
detail: r1 N28 class residue: the refcheck mirrors were cleaned up, but check_session ships dead — nothing dispatches it, and it keeps the auth_api import alive in demo_api.
recommended_fix: Delete demo_api.check_session (and the auth_api import if now unused).

title: download_timeout and store_of still duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam (r1 N31)
detail: The r1 note is unfixed and twofold: two private mirror helpers (download_timeout, store_of) each drift-prone across modules — change the real timeout or seeding policy and the demo copy silently diverges.
recommended_fix: Export one parameterized download_timeout from client.gleam and one store accessor; reuse both from demo_update.

title: Demo still writes comparison/sweep-nudge state to real web storage (r1 N24 unfixed)
detail: Carry-forward: comparison selections and sweep-nudge dismissals still persist from demo mode under the real storage keys, and demo boot hydrates whatever a real session left there — demo ids (a-aoife) can ride into a real comparison tray and vice versa.
recommended_fix: Guard the save_* calls and the handle_browser_change resets with model.demo_mode, and pass [] instead of load_comparison_ids() in demo_entry_effects.

title: Demo banner headline still inline while its copy.gleam constant ships unused
detail: r1 W15 residue: two of three strings moved to copy.gleam, but the banner headline — the demo's most visible landlord-facing string — is inline while its identical constant is dead. Two sources of truth; AGENTS' copy-file rule violated.
recommended_fix: Render copy.demo_banner_message in demo_banner.gleam and delete the inline literal.
